item.name: Aggregates Market Capitalization and Enterprise Value
Get Aggregates Market Capitalization and Enterprise Value view

request.name: Get Aggregates Market Capitalization and Enterprise Value view

description.content:
The Aggregates – Market Capitalization and Enterprise Value package provides market capitalization and enterprise value data, both on diluted and undiluted basis, aggregated by industry classification, using Morningstar’s Morningstar Global Equity Classification Structure, to give industry-wide averages on a country-by-country basis to use to benchmark a company’s value relative to other companies in that industry, industry group, or sector.

The package contains the following dataset:

  * Industry Aggregates - Market Capitalization and Enterprise Value

Most recent and time series data supported.
